chapter.verse: Khatvei Zeisu in tuili geiah thu a hilh lai takin, mihonpite a kiangah kikhawm uh a, amah in tui gei nai-ah a om gunkuang tungah tuangin a tu hi.
Mihonpite in tuili geiah lei tungah a om uh hi. Zeisu in thugentehna tawh thu tampi hilh a, a thuhilhna sungah a gen-inah,
“Ngai un, khaici vawhpa in khaici vawh dingin a kuankhia hi.
Khaici a vawh lai takin kimkhatte in lampi geiah kia a, vasate hong pai-in, tawmin a ne uh hi.
Kimkhatte in lei tam lohna suang lakah kia a, lei a dai manin a po pah hangin,
ni suak a, a sat ciangin zung kha zo lo ahih manin a vulgawp hi.
Kimkhatte in ling lakah a kia hi. Ling kungte khang uh a, dep gawp uh ahih ciangin a gah kei hi.
Kimkhatte in lei hoihna-ah kia a, po-in khang a, a zah sawmthum, a zah sawmguk, a zah zakhat a gah hi.
Zak nading bil a nei teng in za ta un!” a ci hi.
Zeisu in gam daina-ah a om lai takin, sawm-le-nihte tawh a kimkot a omkhawmte in thugentehna a dong uh hi.
Zeisu in, “Pasian’ Gam thu theih hakte na theih nadingun thu hong pia hi. A pua lam a omte ahih uh leh, kikheela amau mawhna uh a kimaisak loh nadingin,
amau enin, a en napi-un a mu kei ding uh a; ngai-in, a ngai napi-un a khiatna thei lo ding uh ahih ciangin, amaute thugentehna tawh ka hilh hi.”
“Note in hih thugentehna thei lo na hi uh hiam? Na theih kei uh leh, thugentehna khempeuh bangci theih ding na hi uh hiam?
Khaici vawhpa in thu a vawh hi.
Lampi geiah khaici a kiate in, thu a zak uh ciangin thakhatin Satan hong pai a, amau sungah a kivawh thu a lakkhiatte ahi uh hi.
Tua mah bangin, suang lakah a kiate in thu a zak uh ciangin, lungdamin a mang pah uh hi.
Amaute sungah zung kha lo uh ahih ciangin, tawlkhat kikal bek a kip uh hi. A thu hangah gimna ahi zongin, bawlsiatna ahi zongin a thuak uh ciangin thakhatin a puk uh hi.
Ling lakah a kiate in, thu a zak uh ciangin leitung lunghihmawhna,
sum leh pai khemna leh, adang deihgawhna lutin thu depgawp a, gah zo lo uh hi.
Lei hoihna ah a kiate in thu a zak uh ciangin mang uh a, a zah sawmthum, a zah sawmguk, a zah zakhat a gah thei ahi uh hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Meivak kho sangah vak loin, seeng khuh ding ahi zongin, lupna nuai-ah koih ding ahi zongin hong kitawi ahi hiam?
A kilak ding longal, a kibu bangmah om lo hi. A kilang ding longal, a ki-im bangmah om lo hi.
Zak nading bil a nei mi khatpeuh a om leh, za ta hen,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Note in bang na ci zak uh hiam ci-in na kikeem ta un. Midangte na piakna uh seeng mahin no zong hong kipia kik ding a, a tam zawin a hong pia ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a neite a kipiak beh ding hi. A nei lote kiang pan a neihsa nangawn a kilakhia ding hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Tua ahih ciangin Vantung Gam in, mi khat in lei tungah khaici a vawh tawh kibang hi.
Sun tawh zan tawh tua pa ihmu zel, tho zel a, ama theih lohin a kung po a, hong khangto hi.
Lei in ama thuin gahsak hi. A masa belin a kung, tua khit ciangin a vui, tua khit ciangin a vui sungah gah taksa a piang thei hi.
A gah a min ciangin, thakhatin ama phiaukawi tawh a at hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, taang lak hun a tung zo hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in, “Pasian Gam bang tawh ka genteh ding hiam? Bang thugentehna tawh ka lak ding hiam?
Ankam tang tawh a kibang hi. Ankam tang lei-ah a kicin’ lai takin, leitungah a om tang khempeuh lakah a neupen hi.
Ahih hangin a kicin’ khit ciangin khang a, ankung khempeuh sangin gol zaw a, vanah vasate in a lim belh dingin hiang gol a meeng thei hi,” a ci hi.
Zeisu in tua bang thugentehna tawh amaute in a theih zawh nadingun thu a hilh hi.
Thugentehna loin thu a hilh kei hi. Ahih hangin thu khempeuh gam daihna-ah a nungzuite a hilh hi.
Tua ni, nitak ciangin Zeisu in a nungzuite kiangah, “Gal khatah pai ni,” a ci hi.
Amaute in mihonpi nusia-in paikhia uh a, gunkuangah amah a om bangin amaute in Topa tawh tuang khawmin a pai uh hi. Gunkuang dangte zong amau tawh a paikhawm uh hi.
Tua lai takin huih nakpi nung a, tui kilok in gunkuang kipap a, gunkuang sungah tui a dim hi.
Zeisu in gunkuang tawlam lukham tungah a ihmu hi. Amaute in phong uh a, “Topa aw, kote kisiat ding nong awi hiam?” a cih uh ciangin
Zeisu thoin huihpi taai a, “Dai in,” ci-in thu a piak ciangin huihnung tawpa a dai pah hi.
Tua lai takin Zeisu in, “Note in bang dinga lau na hi uh hiam? Upna nei lo na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dong hi.
Amaute in lau mahmah uh a, “Hih pa in kua mi ahi hiam? Huih leh tuipi nangawn in a thu ngai tazen uh hi,” ci-in khat leh khat a kikum uh hi.
